en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a dramatic jagged mountain range with rocky peaks rising above dense conifer forests and an alpine valley. In the foreground lies a small town or resort with scattered buildings and open meadows. Handwritten-style white text is printed along the bottom edge of the image, with a small number in the lower right corner.
